body_markdown:
Listen to[Seth Meyers](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/sandra-bullock) ’ new episode of[SmartLess](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/smartless) with Jason Bateman, Sean Hayes, and Will Arnett one week early with SiriusXM’s exclusive early access.


[“Seth Meyers” SiriusXM Early Access Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogSethMeyersSmartLess)


During the episode, Seth was asked where he sees himself five years from now. The longtime *Late Night* host said he’d “love to say” he’s still doing the show, adding that he’s “not tired of it at all” and still genuinely enjoys the job.


- **Related:[Sandra Bullock Talks ‘Practical Magic’ and Her Late Partner on SmartLess](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/sandra-bullock-bryan-randall-smartless)**


Seth also reflected on how much he’s learned from the show, saying his years in late night have given him experience he believes could translate to whatever comes next.


### “Seth Meyers” on *SmartLess*


Can I hear me? It’s the wonderful Seth Meyers. Irons in the fire, squirrel in parentheses, and accepting the cookies. “You can’t put a price on a smile,” … on an all-new *SmartLess* .
